text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 白色露肩短袖抽褶束身短上衣，白色多层荷叶长裙带清晰高侧开衩，鞋未展示不加。配饰：银色细腰链；银色手链。按自然穿搭位置或旁置排列，无人无人台。
original_prompt: Create a complete outfit cover from this white-background unoccupied clothing image. Preserve exactly the white off-shoulder ruched cropped top and tiered maxi skirt with side slit. Add one delicate silver waist chain draped around the skirt waistband and one separate fine silver bracelet placed beside the outfit. No shoes, bags, other jewelry, people, body parts or mannequin. Pure white background, realistic product photography, full objects with margins.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
